snippet.title: Foodomina - Demo Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
✨Demo Coming to PC MAY 16TH! Wishlists now!✨
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3116350/Foodomina/
-------------------------------------------
Foodomina is a Morally Layered, Food vs Mold themed RPG, where you play as 2 personified food girls & fight... MOLD people? In space! Explore a whimsical, galactic food-themed society that's rich in flavour, and engage in absurd, pun-fueled combat to save the galaxy from Mold infection! 🍤💫
☆
☄️ KEY GAME FEATURES 
▪︎ Adventure 🚀
Adventure through space, cute towns, creepy laboratories, and the fantastical landscapes of food themed planets! 🪐 Engage with characters, learn their stories, and collect items... & snacks! 🍫🍕✨️

▪︎ Defend 👾🔫
Defend yourself against MOLD Enemies in battle, to avoid becoming infected! Strategise by equipping different combat abilities & items 💥✨️

▪︎ Cure 💜✨️
Endure a barrage of food puns when interacting with Mold Enemies. Puns are key to knowing what cure to apply for reversing Mold Infection... 
-------------------------------------------
You'll be able to play 2 different game modes- STORY MODE & BATTLE MODE- to have a chance to experience a bit of the Story... and Battle a bunch of quirky Mold enemies... including a Boss Fight! 👾

💫STORY MODE DEMO💫
✰
The Story Demo is a ≅ 30-minute experience, taking place at the beginning of Foodomina’s story! Explore environments, experience some good ol' lore & worldbuilding, and cutscenes! It is a condensed version of the first arc, to ensure all key game features and the core gameplay loop can be reasonably experienced within a shorter timeframe. 🩵🍩
✰
☄️BATTLE MODE DEMO☄️
The Battle Mode is a 30-40 minute experience, taking place in a non-canon, environment, for those looking for a chaotic & absurd challenge! Bback to back Mold Enemy Battles, including more attacks, unlockable combat abilities and a BOSS FIGHT. Currently, these are exclusive to the Battle Mode & not yet present in the Story Demo. 👾
✰
✨WISHLIST to be notified when the DEMO is out!
-------------------------------------------

★ Check out our Devlog series on IG, Tiktok or YT Shorts!
